parents_real() {
  local d acc="$CODE" part; local -a parts
  d=$(dirname -- "$1"); [ "$d" = . ] && return 0
  IFS=/ read -ra parts <<< "$d"
  for part in "${parts[@]}"; do acc="$acc/$part"; [ -L "$acc" ] && return 1; [ -d "$acc" ] || return 1; done

  local d acc="$CODE" part; local -a parts

    acc="$acc/$part"

    [ -d "$acc" ] || mkdir -- "$acc"
  done

  if [ -L "$1" ]; then [ -L "$2" ] && [ "$(readlink -- "$1")" = "$(readlink -- "$2")" ]
